name: deep-round
description: Climb the difficulty rung to its maximum so the escalated wave-spawn renders vs MAME.
_grounding: coin@400 + 1P start@500; hold ERA_RUNG 0xACC0=0x0F + ERA_RUNG_TIMER 0xA9D7=1 + ERA_RUNG_PERIOD 0xA9D6=1 from f620 so the rung tick wraps fast and escalateDifficultyRungOnCounterWrap -> applyEraRungSettings steps the craft spawn slot count 0xACC1 0x05->0x07 (game-set) at ~f1014, held ~307 frames (a dense churning wave). Exercises escalateDifficultyRungOnCounterWrap (0x4D3A) and applyEraRungSettings (0x1A9A); spawnEnemyWaveIntoFreeSlots (0x386E) is era 4's wave and runs in mothership-era4.poke.json, not here (this tape stays in era 0). A ROUND_NUMBER poke (0xAD01) does NOT escalate -- the start-rung bracket is fixed at credit init from the DIP record.
